unit: 棟 (buildings) — quarterly SUM of monthly 建物所有權買賣移轉登記棟數 (building-ownership transfer registrations due to sale), national total
source: 內政部不動產資訊平台 (MOI Real Estate Information Platform) 統計資訊整合查詢, field 交易課稅-建物所有權登記-建物買賣移轉登記棟數 (4_1_3), location=全國/TAIWAN. Query endpoint https://pip.moi.gov.tw/Publicize/Info/E30Query (page https://pip.moi.gov.tw/Publicize/Info/E3010 ; CSV download listing https://pip.moi.gov.tw/Publicize/Info/E3030). Underlying registry: 內政部地政司/統計處 建物所有權登記統計.
notes: pip platform publishes this series QUARTERLY only, earliest period 2000Q4 (ROC 089Q4); latest 2026Q1 (ROC 115Q1). Axis padded back to 1994Q1 per target; 1994Q1-2000Q3 = null (not obtainable from the pip quarterly platform; pre-2000 monthly exists only in the 內政統計月報/MICST legacy frameset at statis.moi.gov.tw which was not cleanly machine-parseable this pass). Each quarterly value = sum of the 3 monthly transfer counts; verified: pip annual sums equal the officially reported annual totals to the exact unit (2016=245,504; 2021=348,194; 2023=306,971; 2024=350,525, matching MOI 內政統計通報 '113年35.1萬棟'). All published quarters are complete (3 months); no partial-quarter nulls. Cycle shape verified: 2001 trough(259k) -> 2005-07 peak(~450k in 2006) -> GFC dip 2008-09 -> elevated 2010-13 -> 2014-16 slide to 2016 low(245k) -> recovery to 2021 peak(348k) -> 2022-23 cooling(307k) -> 2024 rebound(351k) -> sharp 2025 cooling(261k, post Sept-2024 credit controls). Note the 2016Q1 value 43,290 is a real trough from front-loading ahead of the 2016 房地合一稅 (capital-gains tax) start. Definition break: county boundaries changed 2010 (縣市改制) but national total unaffected.
